To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the MIPs can be used for selective separation of malachite green.
the molecularly imprinted polymer can be synthesized using malachite as template molecule, and the molecular imprinting technique has the ability to prepare molecular imprinted polymer.
the molecular imprinted polymeric material was successfully synthesized and the binding site formed in this polymer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a simple and efficient method of synthesis of molecularly imprint polymer.
the synthesis and evaluation of the MIPs.
the preparation of molecularly imprited polymers using MG as template molecule.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the best condition for the synthesis of molecularly im-printed polymers is that the template molecule is 1.0 mmol,L,2- hydroxyethyl methacrylate(HEMA) is 1.5 mmol,ethylene glycol dimethacrylate(EGDMA)is 5.0 mmol,and the ratio of template molecule and functional monomer is 1∶1.

the molecular imprinted polymeric adsorbents were synthesized successfully and the molecularly imprinted polymer was synthesized by using the malachite green and methacryl amide as template and functional monomers respectively.
the molecular imprinted polymeric material with high affinity to MG was obtained by using methacrylic acid as functional monomer and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate as crosslinker.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the molecular imprinting technique is a useful method in the synthesis of molecularly imprints polymer with good recognition ability.
MIPs with high affinity for MG could be synthesized under the optimum conditions.
the molecular imprinted polymeras synthesized under 2-mercaptoethanol and acrylamide as functional monomers and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate as crosslinkers was best for the adsorption of MG.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the molecular imprinted polymeric beads can be prepared using MG as template.
the molecularly imprinted polymer can be synthesized by molecular imprinting technology.
the MIPs can be used as a new adsorbent to remove malachite green from wastewater.
